description: A pick with a head of deepiron, blue-black and colder than the air around it. The Hammerfall clan made one a generation; the deepest rock in the realm still gives way to it.
name: Deepiron Pick
notes: Mining tier 3: three extra swings at every face, hard rock breaks in one strike, and it cuts mithral and adamantine.
Forged by the Forgemistress in Ironpeak from 8 deepiron ore and your dwarven pick, for 2,000 gold.
Wears as you swing it; a smith mends it with deepiron ore.
